remarks: ***MULTIPLE OFFERS. ALL OFFERS DUE BY 5PM TODAY 1/19*** Welcome to this top-floor coveted loft style residence at Eastside Commons, offering refined urban living with serene courtyard views. Located on the 5th floor, this meticulously cared for home has been freshly painted throughout and features engineered hardwood flooring, delivering a polished, move-in ready feel. The open concept layout is highlighted by a dramatic two-story living and dining area, ideal for entertaining or everyday comfort. The kitchen is beautifully updated with all new 2024 stainless steel smart appliances, including gas range, microwave, refrigerator, and dishwasher, along with a center island that flows seamlessly into the main living space. Step out onto your private balcony overlooking the landscaped courtyard. The primary suite offers an ensuite full bath and walk-in closet, while the second bedroom with walk-in closet, additional full bath, and versatile loft space provide flexibility for a home office, den, or guest retreat. Brand new carpeting adds comfort to the bedrooms and loft areas, and in-unit laundry includes a new washer and dryer from 2023. Recent upgrades include a smart thermostat, updated HVAC, and new water heater from 2022. The building offers elevator access, concierge service, a fitness center, courtyard, and shuttle service. Includes 2 parking spaces (1 assigned, 1 floating) in secured underground garage. Incredible walkable location near downtown Stamford.
